metadata.description: Comprehensive database of DISCONTINUED & ABANDONED emulators (1960s-2026)
metadata.note: These emulators are no longer actively maintained but are historically important

nes_discontinued.name: NESticle
nes_discontinued.note: Early popular NES emulator, now replaced by superior alternatives

nes_discontinued.name: Jnes
nes_discontinued.note: Was a solid NES emulator for Windows

snes_discontinued.name: SNES Express
snes_discontinued.note: Windows SNES emulator, superseded by Snes9x

n64_discontinued.name: UltraHLE
n64_discontinued.note: First practical N64 emulator, shut down by Nintendo

playstation_discontinued.name: Bleem!
playstation_discontinued.note: First commercial PS1 emulator, shut down

playstation_discontinued.name: PCSX
playstation_discontinued.note: Original PCSX, replaced by PCSX ReARMed

sega_discontinued.name: Gens 2.14
sega_discontinued.note: Older Genesis emulator, replaced by Gens/GS

dreamcast_discontinued.name: NullDC
dreamcast_discontinued.note: Early Dreamcast emulator, replaced by Flycast

atari_discontinued.name: Stella DOS
atari_discontinued.note: DOS version of Stella, replaced by modern ports

ios.name: Delta
ios.note: Popular iOS emulator, removed from App Store

android_discontinued.name: MyBoy
android_discontinued.note: Popular Game Boy emulator for Android, development stopped

pc_gaming_discontinued.name: ScummVM Legacy
pc_gaming_discontinued.note: Older versions replaced by modern ScummVM

web_based_discontinued.name: Flash-based Emulators
web_based_discontinued.note: All Flash emulators disabled when Flash was deprecated

rare_discontinued.name: Basilisk II
rare_discontinued.note: Mac II emulator, replaced by SheepShaver

console_emulators_discontinued.name: Nestopia UE
console_emulators_discontinued.note: Unofficial Nestopia build, replaced by official Nestopia

experimental_discontinued.name: HLE N64 Emulation
experimental_discontinued.note: Early N64 HLE attempts, replaced by LLE
